messages:
omar: Kicking off a quick thread to align on the SI onboarding + cert plans. Goal: pilot a 4-week enablement for 6 partners, include: playbook, hands-on lab, lightweight cert, marketplace readiness checklist, and co-marketing triggers. Thoughts? :rocket:
sophia: love the scope. Recommend modular playbook: Quickstart (1hr), Implementation (2 days), Advanced Ops (half-day). Keep labs dockerized so partners can run locally. Link to demo repo? https://git.redwood.dev/si-quickstart :eyes:
lin: +1 on modular. Certificates should be micro-badges — pass a practical lab + 20-question quiz. suggest single-sign-on via SSO/SAML and issue a verifiable badge (Credly?).
ben: for timeline, suggest cohort model: week0 onboarding, week1 integrations lab (marketplace + private deploy), week2 QA + performance tuning, week3 go/no-go & co-marketing checklist. We can pilot in June with 4 partners. need eng support for lab envs.
carol: marketing notes — co-announcement triggered only after marketplace listing + at least one joint customer success story. Also need legal to confirm NDA/PR approval cadence. we should prepare a 1-page partner one-pager for press.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: SI enablement planning sync on Thu 10am PT added to calendar: https://calendar.redwood.dev/event/si-enable-2026
sophia: lab infra ops idea: provide an ephemeral dedicated tenant per partner (2 GPUs, isolated), autoscaled for load tests. could use dedicated credits. this avoids local infra variance.
lin: quiz sample idea:
```
1) How to pin a model version in Redwood Private?
2) Steps to configure autoscaling policy for dedicated GPU pool.
3) Troubleshoot: token mismatch in SSO — what logs to check?
```
carol: co-marketing assets list: one-pager, joint blog template, two tweet copy variants, 30s product demo video. ops: who owns video?
ben: eng-ml volunteer list: @sophia, @matt (runtime), @nina (dedicated infra). we should lock 2x 2-hr office hours per week during cohort.
omar: action items so far:
- sophia: draft modular playbook and lab repo by next Wed
- lin: design quiz + badge flow by next Tue
- ben: confirm cohort dates + eng resource calendar
- carol: draft co-marketing asset list and PR gating rules
- product/legal: confirm marketplace listing checklist and NDA template (I'll ping them separately)
Can folks reply with any blockers? :thumbsup:
sophia: no blockers, will start draft.
lin: need credentialing vendor recs — can we budget for Credly or BadgeCraft? I'll open a small PO.
carol: blocked on legal for PR gating timeline. I'll follow up.
ben: need a lab infra runbook from eng-ops. tagging @eng-ops channel after this.
omar: perfect. we'll review drafts in Thu sync. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
